title: SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme
summary: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme The SEC obtained an asset freeze against Backward Hat Capital and its founders, alleging a $560 million Ponzi scheme sold as AI-driven FX trading funded through crypto. Prosecutors and the CFTC filed parallel cases. This post SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws. This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping
